orientation: outside half: rotation 0, outward is UP: nozzles point up into space; the exhaust glow overhangs above the frame (see glow.offset); the bottom 4px are the flange onto the outer wall face
notes: Concord Thruster Mk5, a hull mount (outward is up): the 4x3 nozzle housing with three full bells (the middle one tallest), gold collar rings, heat-sink fins and the Concord gold registry band across the reinforced collar; inside the Mk4 core with a gold-framed hatch and a gold registry band along the wall flange. Damaged: the left bell lip dented and hanging, the right bell cracked and sputtering, a fin torn off, the middle bell cracked, sparks. Disabled: all three bells bent or snapped, the fins gone, the collar cracked (the gold band scorched). THIS FILE: the OUTSIDE half (nozzles, in space against the outer wall face; its bottom 4px are the flange onto the wall). It is never destroyed, only disabled (bent, dead, fixable).
